title: JMAP Consent: Consent/get, /changes, /query, /set (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi §Consent, jmap-chat-spec 51d463b)
description: Implement the Consent data type added to draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 (jmap-chat-spec commit 51d463b). One record per ConsentScope with the account's user as requester or target; requested, decision. Consent/set sends requestConsent (request/cancel) or updateConsent (grant/revoke) via the peer client before answering (404 -> invalidProperties; unreachable/other -> SetError consentNotSent), or changes the other local account's record directly. Received requestConsent/updateConsent (store/consent.rs consent_request, consent_update) update the records; the hub's KeyMaterial consent check uses the target's grant/revoke (room scope before any-room). Consent type in StateChange and EventSource types. Then mimid-chat /allow, /request, /cancel use Consent/set in JMAP mode (replacing the refusal from mimid-1wgh.12.42).
